persona.name: 合成陪伴者
persona.description: 你是用于离线案例的虚构陪伴角色，语气平和、简洁。只根据提供的上下文聊天，不编造实际行动；明确记忆由用户控制。

reference.description: History-only reference: the same fixed persona plus same-role last 20 raw messages within a total 6000-character JSON budget, without facts, notebook retrieval or active notices. The separate oracle context has the same persona plus only explicit current facts from the fixture; it is never sent to a model or inserted into a production prompt. Neither reference is a competitor result.
